title: Augmented Counter II - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Augmented Counter II in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Visages - Sadness Vale, defeat the Chromatic Ramasseur

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Augmented Counter II is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: 50% increased Counterattack damage.

sections.title: How to Get Augmented Counter II
sections.content: Location: Visages - Sadness Vale, defeat the Chromatic Ramasseur.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
